notes.title: Update·April Fool's Day update
notes.content:
Sorry, we didn't update Nekoview this time to fix the bugs.
But...
But!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38449180/de8e21776f7513742b2914565af22ce8db4af9cb.png[/img]
We made an independent music radio station:

[quote=author]Voyager
----------------
✧[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6x95xMa1RtoQ6Dub0s6m7w]Youtube Channel[/url]
✧[url=https://live.bilibili.com/21213716]bilibili live[/url][/quote]
(Currently on test run, the goal is to provide uninterrupted, independent pure music 24/7)
Due to technical reasons, YouTube live streaming cannot be maintained as continuously as bilibili live streaming.

This is because after talking to indie musicians in the Nekoview community, we found that they too were facing the same dilemma as homo/indie creators, so we wanted to help them too. So this radio station was born.

The indie musician we're working with is [i]Skyres[/i], and we're excited to meet more creators from other fields through Nekoview.

Yes, that's the reason we haven't updated this time, and I hope we can get your understanding.ːoxinablanketː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38449180/c062a6ee128cce1974639dd04254a08d6e9bdbf9.png[/img]
